name: PaneLayout
description:
Panels in a JSON tree of splits and stacks, in one bounded box. Hosts own the panels and their
ids; a stack with several shows tabs. Panels move between stacks and splits by drag or the
Move to menu without remounting, and a saved layout keeps ids that no longer resolve.
signature: ({ panel, layout: layoutProp, defaultLayout, onLayoutChange, locked, collapseBelow, onUnknownPanels, storageKey, name, chrome, moving, className, ...rest }: PaneLayoutProps): React.JSX.Element

props.name: chrome
props.description:
`panel` (default): each stack is a Panel with `--gap-panels` between. `flush`: one surface.
A layout drawn in `overlay` placement draws each stack as its own Panel whatever this says,
since a floating stack needs its own material.

props.name: collapseBelow
props.description: Below this width the layout collapses to one panel and a strip. Default "40rem", as SplitPane.

props.name: defaultLayout
props.description: The layout an uncontrolled PaneLayout starts with when none is remembered.

props.name: locked
props.description: Resize only: no moving, closing or tabs drag. For mail and dashboards.

props.name: moving
props.description:
A gesture is moving the content under floating stacks (a pan, a zoom, a scrub): while true
they take the material's `data-moving` treatment, an opaque fill instead of a blur of
something that changes every frame. Set it for the gesture only. Ignored while docked.
Panels can say the same with `usePaneLayout().setMoving`.

props.name: name
props.description: Tells several layouts in one window kind apart in storage. Default "layout".

props.name: onLayoutChange
props.description: Called once per finished change, never during a drag. A phone's collapsed view reports only closes.

props.name: onUnknownPanels
props.description: Called with ids `panel` could not resolve, and again when that list changes.

props.name: panel
props.description: Resolves an id. `null` means the id is unknown: it stays in the JSON, dormant and invisible, until it resolves again. Pass a stable function.

props.name: storageKey
props.description:
Where an uncontrolled layout is remembered (localStorage). Inside a window body it defaults
to one key per window kind (`glass-ux.panes:window:<kind>:<name>`); elsewhere nothing is
remembered unless you pass one. null turns it off.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
